description: Builds the unsigned Base Mainnet transactions that lock USDC in escrow for one directory listing: the provider gets the price if the oracle finds the endpoint meets your latency limit; otherwise you get the price plus the 2% fee back. Use it to pay a provider conditionally; to check without paying, use check_endpoint. A wallet the endpoint vouches for (x402 payTo, /.well-known/agentsla.json or a _agentsla TXT record) is always paid; an unverified wallet (providerVerified false) is paid while its payouts stay within 1,000 USDC per 30 days, and beyond that the payout waits at the job's claim link and is refunded to you after 6 days. Calling it changes nothing: your wallet signs a USDC approve (if needed) and createJob, then you call register_escrow_terms with the createJob hash. Returns the transactions, the total to approve and the listing.

apiId.description: Listing id of the endpoint being paid for (from discover_monitored_apis or get_api_details), e.g. 29002.

priceUsdc.description: Price in USDC, e.g. 1.5. The payer approves price + 2%.

providerAddress.description: Wallet that receives the price if the SLA is met. Always paid if the endpoint vouches for it (x402 payTo, /.well-known/agentsla.json {"payoutAddresses":["0x..."]} or a TXT record at _agentsla.<domain>: agentsla-payout=0x...); otherwise paid within 1,000 USDC per 30 days and held beyond that until it does.

walletAddress.description: Payer wallet on Base Mainnet that signs and funds the job.
